verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss is a CRM, so running multiple pipelines with distinct stage sets is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents multiple pipelines or configurable per-pipeline stage sets. The only stage reference is the Trash stage filter in the People API, which is an adjacent detail and not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions
